subject: Meeting during Hannover Mess | Scaling Data Pipelines at [COMPANY]
text:
Hi [NAME]​, 

Saw that you were at Hannover Mess this week, given you lead product for production defect detection, thought I'd reach out. I work in the AI Industrial Inspection team here at Encord (focused on data curation, annotation & model evaluation, ~6 years old, 100+ employees & $50M+ funding) and we're working with a few of your peers (LandingAI, eSmart, Tractable, UVEye, Baker Hughes, etc.) to develop high quality AI training data pipelines as these teams look to scale.

I saw this was a focus for your team at the moment. Keen to get your thoughts on what we're building if you're be open to a 30-minute chat this week or the next ? Pretty open Thursday and Friday this week.

subject: Encord <> [COMPANY] | Catch-up
text:
Hi [NAME],

Hope all's well. Saw you and Deniz were in touch with my former colleague
[SENDER] last year as you looked to streamline your data annotation process and
modernize your data workflows. At the time, a couple areas of the platform
seemed to stand out:

   - Splitting complex labeling into optimized stages to reduce
   human-in-the-loop costs and accelerate throughput.
   - Configurable workflows with model pre-labeling, confidence-based
   routing, and expert review-ideal for scaling your hybrid data pipeline.
   - Embedding-powered curation to quickly fix SKU misclassifications.
   - SDK integration to plug in your existing product recognition models

Would it make sense to reconnect? Happy to continue the discussion you
started.

subject: Met Margaret & Victoria | Working w/ Captions & Synthesia
text:
Hi [NAME]​, 

I recently met Margaret & Victoria from your team who mentioned the team's might be using Labelbox. We actually work closely with Synthesia & Captions who moved over from LB to improve the quality of their multimodal AI models.

We're seeing more sophisticated teams turning to us to advance model training with post-training flows like RLHF using Likert scales or curating multimodal data. Thought this could be relevant to your work on the Multilingual / Scribe models. 

Keen to chat either way and get your candid feedback on what we're building here at Encord. Would you be open to a quick 20 mins catch up in the coming weeks? Wednesdays and Thursdays work best for me.

subject: Working w/ Captions & Synthesia | State of Marketing & AI report
text:

I've been following (and using) Canva for a while, so I'd love to chat and get your candid feedback on what we're building here at Encord. Would you be open to a quick 20-minute catch-up in the coming weeks? Wednesdays and Thursdays work best for me.

subject: Working w/ Riot Games & EA | [COMPANY] La Forge
text:

This includes leveraging sophisticated multimodal data visualization and curation techniques, as well as accelerating R&D efforts by enabling easy testing and monitoring of new projects and ideas.

I've been following [COMPANY] for a while, so I'd love to chat and get your candid feedback on what we're building here at Encord. Would you be open to a quick 20-minute catch-up in the coming weeks? Wednesdays and Thursdays work best for me.
